# data-analysis-with-llms-benchmark
Docker-reproducible benchmark verifying Trummer Data Analysis with LLMs Ch.1-10 on public data. 6 offline experiments, digests in results/. MIT.
- Quickstart: pip install -r requirements.txt && python scripts/verify_all.py --offline
- Docker: docker compose up --build
- Docs: README.md, docs/METHODOLOGY.md, docs/DEMO.md, papers/OUTLINE.md
